ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels; the surface is dominated by low-reflectance pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the fluke body; distinct high-contrast circular blobs (0.01-0.03 fluke-width diameter) are localized primarily on the left-distal margin and leading edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits a continuous sequence of low-amplitude serrations; left lobe trailing edge displays irregular, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a high-convexity arc (rounded); right lobe presents an elongated, low-concavity sweep towards a sharp distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast circular nodes (white/light gray) detected along the convex perimeter of the left lobe, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macro-level irregularities and calcified protrusions (barnacles) along the left fluke margin and surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant bilateral asymmetry; the left lobe is truncated and rounded with heavy biofouling, while the right lobe is elongated and more structurally intact.
